description: This Java source file defines the class 'OrbitalPaymentServices', which provides a set of static methods for handling payment transactions via the Orbital payment gateway. It includes methods for authorization, capture, refund, release, and their respective transaction processing, along with utility functions for request building, configuration, and response handling. The class interacts with the Orbital SDK interfaces and Ombiz's entity services, and integrates with the OFBiz framework's service chain.

classes.name: OrbitalPaymentServices
classes.description: The class provides static methods for performing various payment transactions via the Orbital payment gateway, including authorization, capture, refund, release, and their processing routines. It manages SDK interactions, configuration, and response handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs an authorization-only transaction through Orbital SDK, building and validating the request, and processing the response to determine the success of authorization.

methods.name: ccAuthCapture
methods.description: Carries out an authorization and capture transaction, performing request preparation, validation, SDK processing, and response handling.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Processes prior authorization to capture funds, constructs capture request, and handles the response.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Performs a refund for a previous transaction, preparing the refund request and handling the response.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Releases or voids a previous authorization transaction, preparing the release request and processing the response.

methods.name: buildOrbitalProperties
methods.description: Constructs the configuration properties needed for connecting to the Orbital SDK, reading from the database and property files.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific configuration values from the 'PaymentGatewayOrbital' entity based on the payment gateway config ID.

methods.name: buildAuthOrAuthCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Builds the request for authorization or authorization+capture transactions including setting fields such as amount, credit card info, addresses, and comments.

methods.name: buildCaptureTransaction
methods.description: Builds the request for capture transactions, referencing prior authorization transaction data.

methods.name: buildRefundTransaction
methods.description: Builds the refund transaction request with necessary details such as amount, card info, and order ID.

methods.name: buildReleaseTransaction
methods.description: Builds the request to reverse or release a previous authorization.

methods.name: initializeTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Initializes the TransactionProcessor instance for SDK communications.

methods.name: processCard
methods.description: Executes the transaction request via the SDK and captures the response.

methods.name: processAuthTransResult
methods.description: Processes the SDK response for authorization transactions, populates the results map accordingly.

methods.name: processAuthCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Handles responses for authorization+capture transactions, updating results map.

methods.name: processCaptureTransResult
methods.description: Processes SDK response for capture operations.

methods.name: processRefundTransResult
methods.description: Handles the SDK response for refund transactions.

methods.name: processReleaseTransResult
methods.description: Handles the SDK response for release transactions.

methods.name: printTransResult
methods.description: Logs details of the ResponseIF object for debugging.

methods.name: formatExpDateForOrbital
methods.description: Formats expiration date string into required format for requests.

methods.name: getShippingRefForOrder
methods.description: Retrieves tracking code info for an order to include as shipping reference in the transaction request.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates the request parameters before processing; currently a stub returning success.
